Colophon

The Build and Back-End
  • Built with 11ty (now Build Awesome)
  • Deployed with Netlify
  • Hosted at Github
  • Versioning with Git
Programming Languages
  • JavaScript (ESM) on the backend/server side
  • Designed with CSS
  • Used the Nunjucks templating language for layouts along with HTML
  • Content written in Markdown parsed with markdown-it
